Bug_Title: RE: Invalid syntax for regular expression (RE_BAD_SYNTAX_FOR_REGULAR_EXPRESSION)
Bug_Details:
The code here uses a regular expression that is invalid according to the syntax
for regular expressions. This statement will throw a PatternSyntaxException when
executed.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by using an invalid regular expression '[', which is missing a closing bracket. This will throw a PatternSyntaxException when the Pattern.compile method is called.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method with an input string. Inside the showBug method, the invalid regular expression '[' is compiled, which results in a PatternSyntaxException. The test case checks if the returned description matches the expected error message, causing the test to fail.
